_about: Robert Drew Hicks (1850-1929), Cambridge classicist, editor of Aristotle's De Anima. Raw IA OCR: Stoic and Epicurean, Epochs of Philosophy series (New York: Scribner, 1910). His Loeb Diogenes Laertius (1925) is Greek facing and held back like the other Greek-facing Loebs. Not Elias Hicks (shelf elias-hicks). US public domain. No uids minted.
